newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian airport interest expressions close.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian airport interest expressions close.

text.p: Expressions of interests for Australia's Brisbane, Melbourne and Perth airports closed on Thursday, an Australian government spokesman said.
The government called for expressions of interests last month as part of the first stage of its A$2.0 billion airport sell-off plan.
"Expressions of interest had to be in by 4.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) today," a spokesman for Finance Minister John Fahey told Reuters.
However, the government would not release details about the potential bidders or how many bids were likely to be made.
The remaining airports are scheduled to be sold in 1997/98 with the possible exception of Sydney airport and the planned second Sydney airport.
The sale of the two Sydney airports is being delayed as a result of noise and environment studies.
Several domestic and foreign investors have publicly declared their interest in bidding for the first round of airports.

Queensland-government owned Suncorp Insurance and Finance and the Queensland Industry Development Corp said earlier on Thursday they wanted to join the Queensland Airport Corporation Ltd consortium in bidding for Brisbane airport.
Earlier this week, National Mutual Holdings Ltd's funds management unit joined the Victoria Airports Ltd consortium to bid for Melbourne airport.
Manchester Airport Plc, SERCO Aviation Services Pty Ltd and Macquarie Bank Ltd are also members of the Melbourne consortium.
